performances.name: Watch the path
performances.brief: Silent eyes scanning the path

performances.name: Menacing pacing
performances.brief: Threatening curved pacing through three-quarter and side views, eyes scanning first, shoulders and hands lagging; vary depth without sliding a rigid sprite.

performances.name: Loom forward
performances.brief: Start small and distant, look toward viewer, accelerate on a curved path with foreshortened hands, brake into a big hovering pose and settle; fixed camera.

performances.name: Drift into darkness
performances.brief: Eyes lead a three-quarter turn; show the back, sweep diagonally into depth until tiny, dissolve completely, hold black, then return through a coherent fog reformation.

performances.name: Suspicious inspection
performances.brief: Lean down and inspect an imaginary visitor

performances.name: Hear something
performances.brief: Earless listening tilt and eye lead

performances.name: Playful growl
performances.brief: Short theatrical growl with body compression

performances.name: Peek from fog
performances.brief: Eyes appear before full body reforms

performances.name: Floating eyes
performances.brief: Body dissolves while independent eyes linger

performances.name: Vanish and reform
performances.brief: Anticipatory compression, full-body vapor dissolution including hands and core, brief empty black stage, eyes emerge and body reforms; no accidental tail loss.

performances.name: Spooky beckon
performances.brief: One hand curls invitingly with delayed shoulder

performances.name: False-safety reveal
performances.brief: Operator-armed big-kid reveal; never automatic

performances.name: Evil chuckle
performances.brief: Shoulders and hands overlap with a short laugh

performances.name: Ghost shiver
performances.brief: Compression and ripple travel through body

performances.name: Turn and leave
performances.brief: Actual side and back reveal with departing sweep

performances.name: Become scary
performances.brief: One continuous cute-to-scary transformation

performances.name: Become friendly
performances.brief: Hands, teeth and eyes soften coherently

performances.name: Welcome wave
performances.brief: One broad friendly wave

performances.name: Friendly listening
performances.brief: Continuous fuller body life; existing clip is provisional

performances.name: Costume delight
performances.brief: Notice costume, brighten and gesture

performances.name: Pirate greeting
performances.brief: Ahoy! Guarding any treasure?

performances.name: Witch greeting
performances.brief: Love the hat. Is your broom parked?

performances.name: Hero greeting
performances.brief: A hero! My candy is safe!

performances.name: Skeleton greeting
performances.brief: Nice bones. Very fashionable.

performances.name: Pumpkin greeting
performances.brief: You look gourd-geous!

performances.name: Trick or treat
performances.brief: A little boo, a little treat!

performances.name: Boo rehearsal
performances.brief: Boo! Was that spooky enough?

performances.name: Halloween dance
performances.brief: A playful corkscrew with actual side/back views, independent arms and wrist follow-through, a small somersault and buoyant recovery; keep all vapor inside reserve.

performances.name: Treat gratitude
performances.brief: Happy haunting! Save me a sweet.

performances.name: Goodbye bow
performances.brief: Bye, little boo! Then return to living idle

productionIntegration.status: planned; not connected to live voice or phone in this source rehearsal
rules: Guest speech and operator cues preempt attract shows.
Only the laptop owns audible playback and microphone.
Little-ones mode bypasses menacing clips; no automatic age detection.
Goodbye closes the conversation and returns to an approved living idle before the show resumes.
Resume at an approved idle boundary, never halfway through a spoken sentence.
No crossfade of incompatible body silhouettes or doubled ghosts.

spatialPerformance.status: Authoring contract; planned footage is not generated by these settings
spatialPerformance.stage: Fixed camera and pure black negative space; ghost moves through an implied projection volume
motionRules: Animate articulated body perspective, occlusion and turn before scale changes; never scale a stiff cutout as a substitute for depth.
Use anticipation, acceleration, overshoot and settling with lagging body-attached vapor.
Normal acting preserves the connected core. Deliberate disappearance must visibly dissolve the entire being, then reform coherently.
No camera pan or zoom, solid fish curls, hard outlines, screen-wide smoke or silhouette crossfades.
Invisible holds can connect departure and arrival clips only after all smoke clears.
Return to a compatible authored pose and velocity for visible loop joins.
acceptance: Review full-speed footage and all-frame effect bounds, including faint smoke.
Inspect side/back identity and hand/fog occlusion during depth motion.
Approve joins at playback speed; frame similarity alone is insufficient.
Rehearse actual mapped surface before claiming floating illusion works on site.
